notes: Fourth comparison in the family THE-ROOT-IDENTITY-COMPARISONS-FOLD-BEFORE-THEY-REFUSE shipped; that stamp fold is unreachable without it: membership gates ahead of `stampVerdict` at both readers. The note's upstream suspect — `worktreesBase` composing from the arriving spelling — closes here: both sides fold at the one comparison.
